sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last five outings showing resilience. They face a struggling Alsager side languishing near the bottom with just four points, making this a favourable fixture for the leaders to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to keep pace with Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between third and fifth place, with both teams needing to arrest recent poor form—Bridgnorth have lost their last two while Eccleshall bounced back with a win. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash, then host Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town (sixth) travel to Foley Meir, while mid-table sides Barnton visit Shawbury United and New Mills host Market Drayton Town. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a basement-area fixture, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in another lower-table encounter, and Brereton Social begin their week at home to struggling Widnes Town.
